context.summary: The balanced effective-N metric intentionally weights false accepts and false rejects equally; the experiment documentation identifies unequal error costs as the next generalization.

objective: Generalize effective_n_balanced with optional false_accept_cost and false_reject_cost parameters that default to 1.0, preserve existing callers, reject a non-positive total cost, and compute the reference error from the normalized cost-weighted mean of measured false accepts and false rejects.

outputs.description: Unverified candidate patch against the frozen source revision.
